workload.script:
import os, json
i = os.environ.get('AICN_TASK_INDEX', '?')
task = os.environ.get('AICN_TASK')
params = json.loads(task) if task else {}
print(f'task {i} running with params={params}', flush=True)
out = os.environ['AICN_OUTPUT_DIR']
open(os.path.join(out, f'task_{i}.txt'), 'w').write(f'result of task {i}: {params}\n')
print('task', i, 'done', flush=True)
